remarks: Highest and Best by Sunday, 1/25/26 at 5:00PM. PLEASE SEE MANAGING MULTIPLE OFFER GUIDLINES IN SUPPLEMENTS.  Completely re-architected in 2003- with many recent updates-this stunning, 4 bedroom, 3 full bath home is truly move-in ready. Beautifully situated on a desirable cul-de-sac, the main level offers a sun-filled, open-concept with a thoughtfully remodeled kitchen with high-end SS appliances, Thermador gas cooktop, Bosch double ovens, and quartz counters. The adjacent family room for gatherings has hardwood floors and a cozy fireplace accented by a hand-hewn mantle beam. The first floor also includes a versatile office/bedroom or playroom with an updated full bath, a bright dining room with sliders to the bluestone patio and views of the backyard, and a spacious mudroom designed to keep daily life organized. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a luxurious, spa-like updated bath with heated tile floors, double sinks, a soaking tub, a separate shower, and a large walk-in closet. Three additional generously sized bedrooms, all with hardwood floors, an updated full bath and a convenient laundry location complete the second level. Ideally located minutes from downtown Wilton and Ridgefield, it has access to Quarry Head State Park trails and hiking. Full house generator too. This exceptional home is a must see!
